facts.fact: A national cybersecurity reference framework for AI systems, presented by ASIN on 2026-10-08, sets four risk tiers from minimal to unacceptable with controls, an AI officer and ethics committee, and filtering and human validation for generative AI against manipulated content; it is reported as presented, not adopted.
